scope: Supervised domain adaptation of SIGGRAPH 2026 Raster2Seq to FloorFlow native raster inputs

inference_contract.input: native CubiCasa raster resized to 256x256 RGB
inference_contract.postprocessing: Raster2Seq decode followed by FloorFlow explicit-room conversion

gates.trend: Beat matched zero-shot Raster2Seq on the same native raster in Room IoU and instance F1 after 8 epochs or a documented plateau.
gates.promotion: Calibration64 Room IoU >= 0.35, instance F1 >= 0.30, type accuracy >= 0.55, and count MAE <= 3.0.
gates.holdout: Offset128 agrees within 0.03 absolute Room IoU and instance F1.
gates.reasonableness: Validity 1.0, wall continuity >= 0.95, functional watertightness >= 0.95, plan plausibility >= 0.95 after explicit-plan conversion.
